{{Top|leg}}
'''Lover's Kiss''' was a small bar that was located in [[Hedrett]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and it operated during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Gruunelda]], a [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] in the [[Office of Peace and Security]], liked to visit it in her spare time.
